paragraphs.text:
You  shove  Norman  and  Sylvia  to  their  feet.  The  three  of 
you sprint for the  deep woods. Fear drives you through  the 
undergrowth, lending you enough extra speed to counter your 
pursuers’ knowledge of the landscape.
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 147; if you fail, go to 575.
